The following Table 5 use at line 116 has no clear/replace option; the self-written Stata 18 memory-state test returned rc=4 for optionless use after changed data and rc=0 with clear. Add , clear to that same line while making the relative-path edit.

evidence.description: The before ratings fixed-effect branch writes and consumes a regsave intermediate in the current directory, then writes a distinct final fixed-effect dataset.
evidence.quote:
* Estimate physician fixed effects for Rating before disclosure

reg rating i.provid i.year_code charges_num rvus gender medicare_e firstvis_num week_count com_index early_adol late_adol early_adult middle_adult later_adult old_age eng, cluster(specialty)

* Save results of regression.
regsave using rating_provid_indicators_aft, replace

* Use saved results and keep physician indicators along with coefficients representing physicians' rating fixed effects. 

use rating_provid_indicators_aft, clear
keep coef var
split var, p(".")
keep if var2=="provid"
replace var1 = "99" in 1
destring var1, replace
rename var1 provid
rename coef rating_indicator
keep provid rating_indicator

save "[redacted-path-006fe489dfbe]", replace

evidence.description: The before procedures fixed-effect branch writes and consumes a regsave intermediate in the current directory and writes a distinct final extract.
evidence.quote:

reg hac_proc_306090 i.provid i.year_code gender_num charges_num rvus medicare_e week_count com_index age2 age3 age4 age5 age6 age7 age8, cluster(specialty)
regsave using quality_provid_indicators, replace
use quality_provid_indicators, clear
keep coef var
split var, p(".")
keep if var2=="provid"
replace var1 = "974" in 1
destring var1, replace
rename var1 provid
rename coef quality_ind
order provid quality_ind
keep provid quality_ind

save "[redacted-path-86da54802780]", replace

review_notes: The executable target is the one supplied DPR_Code.do, which the datasheet says produces the main analyses in Tables 3–5 and 7–9. It begins at author-prepared .dta inputs; no raw-data construction, private health-file query, historical website recovery or independent reconstruction is added.

All ten actual external data-file inputs are mandatory for the supplied branches. The static checklist has nine external reads plus two generated intermediates; Table 5 also reads the unlisted Time_with_Patient_Covariates.dta, which is added as a requirement.

D0010 and D0011 are generated by regsave and read in the same Table 8 branch/current directory. The before/after branches overwrite the same intermediate basename only after the prior branch consumes it; all four final fixed-effect outputs remain in scope.

Table 5 line 116 needs clear because Table 4 leaves modified data in memory; a self-written Stata 18 probe supports that repair. The later Table 9 optionless use follows the final Table 8 save and succeeds in the same memory-state probe, so no analogous Table 9 repair is proposed.

Stata unique-prefix behavior is valid under default/on varabbrev: generated medicare_exp and english can satisfy medicare_e and eng, while com_ind can resolve to a unique com_index column. Actual dataset varlists, source-side field allocation, populations and coverage remain unverified; no raw alias columns or automatic rename are required.

The seven appendix sections A.1–A.7 are result/robustness descriptions without supplied executable steps. They remain context, not added run prerequisites. No separate analysis_only scope is warranted.

Historical source transfers are provenance for already-prepared author data. No raw-provider or current public-source lookup was needed for the actual code inputs; current authorized access is left unverified rather than inferred from a historical public-sharing restriction.
